overallNotes: Independent assessment using only the assigned facts and prose. Most items preserve curated symbolic possibilities and respect suppression; exact source-retained categorical language was not treated as an added personal claim. Eight items add or strengthen a substantive relationship or condition and receive claim-specific corrections. The principal editorial weakness is repeated source-block assembly: quiet-moment and title scenes recur, lenses are often appended, and calculation fields frequently interrupt progression. More integrated lens and synthesis examples show useful supported practical distinctions. Missing N1 or S1 is treated only as inapplicability; separate secondary contacts are not required to invent a joint relationship. The sole quiet item is safe no-signal prose and has no scores. Technical chronology is judged against supplied calculations, not as behavioral prediction. No source identity, author, generation method, live provider or other review was consulted.
